author: regression-suite
note: Echo's Watch and Learn: after an aspect or basic event is played, tuck it under Echo instead of letting it reach the discard pile. Rhino at 11 proves Haymaker actually resolved (14 - 3) rather than being silently discarded out of the processing area unpaid, and tucked:1 proves it went under Echo rather than to the player discard pile. Neither assertion passes alone: an unresolved Haymaker still leaves Rhino at 14, and a resolved-but-untucked one still leaves tucked at 0. This is the cross-player tuck machinery the project notes flagged as the real Echo gap -- z00lus implements it as AfterPlayerPlayedCard with "AnyPlayer", which is why it can see another player's event at all.
